===== NOT RUN (need hardware / lock)
CLUSTER_LOCK on spark-one held at every check this session (14:45Z, 14:54Z: owner=claude, window w1d, eta 18:35:59Z), so per brief rule 4 nothing was compiled: build_pdl.sh, vet-pdl on a real build and tools/ptx_check_g25.py (Triton lowering) are NOT run. device_test.py --part g25/g18 and tools/g18_gate.py need a GPU on a stopped node (the lead's job; this agent has no GPU). G18 therefore stays partial and fail-closed: install.py refuses an unvetted binary and installs one only after vet-pdl + the device gate.
